nodes.label: UMS - lightweight build orchestration for Prismio projects
nodes.rationale: Intentionally not a general-purpose scripting language. Reads build.ums from the current directory; supports `ums build`/`ums run`, auto-invokes prismio.exe. Recognized calls: prismio("path-or-command"), source("src/main.psm"), output("build/app.exe"), args("--example"). Unknown blocks (packages, cSources, extra module decls) are reserved for later expansion — the config shape deliberately leaves room to grow.
